_comment: Model manifest for Rebirth: Eclipse System. Each entry maps a model KEY (the id the game's code/data references, e.g. HeroStage.armorSetId, EnemyArchetype.enemyId) to a Tripo3D generation prompt and a target import path. Generate via Tools/tripo_generate.py (text-to-3D) or by hand on studio.tripo3d.ai, export GLB, and drop the file at targetPath. Characters that need rigging should use Tripo's rig step or an external rig — see Docs/Build/03_ModelPipeline_Tripo3D.md.
styleGuide: stylized anime dark-fantasy, PBR game-ready topology, clean silhouette, black/silver palette with violet accents for Eclipse-aligned subjects, neutral A-pose for characters, no base/ground plane, single asset centered
